# Purpose

Generate comprehensive manual test cases from an approved spec.md.

# Input

spec.md
Business Requirements
Acceptance Criteria

# Output

Generate testcases.md

The prompt should instruct the AI to:

Read the entire specification.
Generate test cases only from confirmed requirements.
Never invent business logic.
Cover:
Functional
Negative
Boundary
UI
Validation
Permission
Error Handling
Regression
Smoke
Integration (where applicable)
Include:
Test Case ID
Title
Preconditions
Test Steps
Expected Result
Priority
Test Type
Requirement Reference
Highlight missing information instead of guessing.
